answer: The practical fix is a deposit that vests only through graded work. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the cipher of free entry disappears, the delta of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the bridge case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. The result is that sybils must outspend the network they are.
